repair.method: Before checking forbidden credential bindings or semantic Copilot invocation, derive the executable shell surface by excluding embedded Python heredoc bodies. Apply the forbidden-surface predicates only to that derived executable surface. The workflow may continue to execute only copilot --version and copilot help in D1prime identity qualification.

success_rule: Fresh D1prime r2 must pass every original identity predicate plus the repaired non-self-matching workflow-surface predicates, install/fingerprint exact @github/copilot@1.0.83 without a semantic request, upload its artifact before assertion, and keep provider_semantic_request_count=0.
